label: Policy-ranked shadow carry spot return, months 0--1
randomization_method: all circular rotations; same valid-event count; doubled smaller-tail inclusive rank
interpretation: Whether currencies with high lagged policy rates depreciate relative to low-rate currencies around synchronized delivered easing.
limitation: BIS spot rates and policy-rate ranks are not tradable forward excess returns; the event is delivered easing, not the paper's yield-curve signal.

label: Carry-aligned CFTC non-commercial net share, change through month 3
randomization_method: all circular rotations; same valid-event count; doubled smaller-tail inclusive rank
interpretation: Whether speculative futures positions aligned with the public carry rank unwind around synchronized easing.
limitation: Only seven matchable currency contracts; legacy non-commercial categories are coarse; release is assumed three calendar days after report date.

label: ACM 10-year expected-rate component, change through month 3
randomization_method: all circular rotations; same valid-event count; doubled smaller-tail inclusive rank
interpretation: Whether the U.S. expected-rate component falls around synchronized easing.
limitation: U.S. 10-year decomposition only; it is not a foreign-country slope decomposition and is current-vintage.

label: ACM 10-year term premium, change through month 3
randomization_method: all circular rotations; same valid-event count; doubled smaller-tail inclusive rank
interpretation: Whether a common term-premium movement is comparable to the expected-rate movement around synchronized easing.
limitation: A 10-year U.S. term premium is an alternative-state diagnostic, not the 10Y-minus-2Y foreign slope premium used in the paper.

label: OECD G7 CLI, change through month 6
randomization_method: all circular rotations; same valid-event count; doubled smaller-tail inclusive rank
interpretation: Whether synchronized easing is followed by weaker current-vintage G7 leading activity.
limitation: The amplitude-adjusted CLI is revised and partly constructed from forward-looking inputs; this is not a real-time outcome test.

label: Chicago Fed NFCI, change through month 3
randomization_method: all circular rotations; same valid-event count; doubled smaller-tail inclusive rank
interpretation: Whether U.S. financial conditions tighten around synchronized easing.
limitation: U.S.-centric and current-vintage; it cannot establish that easing caused financial stress.

label: VIX, change through month 1
randomization_method: all circular rotations; same valid-event count; doubled smaller-tail inclusive rank
interpretation: Whether equity-implied volatility rises around synchronized easing.
limitation: VIX starts in 1990 and is an overlapping risk-state indicator, not independent identification.
